image_credits.description:
ImageCredits is populated by GetBoulder only, never by listBoulders --
hence omitempty, so list responses stay byte-identical. An image with
no entry here was added by this boulder's own creator; see
internal/photocredits for why absent means the creator rather than
unknown.

filed_uncertain.description:
FiledUncertain records that the contributor said "Not sure which one"
rather than "It's a new rock" when this rock was created implicitly by
the add sheet (handoff-add-sheet.md C11). Three-state on purpose:
true said so, false said it was new, nil was never asked -- every
other creation path leaves it nil rather than guessing.

image_credits.description:
ImageCredits is populated by GetCrag only, never by listCrags -- hence
omitempty, so list responses stay byte-identical. See
internal/photocredits for why an absent entry means this crag's own
creator rather than an unknown uploader.

ImageCredits covers this problem's own beta/action shots only -- the
topo photo belongs to the boulder and carries the boulder's credits.
Populated by GetProblem only, never by listProblems, hence omitempty.
See internal/photocredits for why an absent entry means this problem's
own creator rather than an unknown uploader.

info.description: Backend API for Palabatu, a community app for Indonesian bouldering enthusiasts (spot map, climber profiles, route/problem listings, comments, reactions, reports).
info.title: Palabatu API

post.description: Creates the approach and every step in one call. Requires at least one step, each with a photo and a caption. Gated by authz.CanContribute (creator-or-admin today, see handoff.md decision 22).

delete.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title), or the approach's own creator.

get.description: The reading view's one call -- every step, in order, ready for offline caching.
get.summary: Get an approach guide, with its ordered steps

post.description: Any authenticated user may add a boulder to any crag, including someone else's; no role gate.

get.description: Admin-only (Council/Associate title) review queue, with every objection filed against each request embedded.

post.description: Only the source or target boulder's own creator may object. Informs the admin's decision, does not block it.

oneOf.description: Why this isn't the same rock

requestBody.description: Why this isn't the same rock

post.summary: Object to a suggested merge ("this is not the same rock")

post.description: Admin-only. action="merge" requires survivor_id (the admin's pick of which boulder survives) and is blocked by a 48h objection hold unless override_hold is set. action="reject" needs no wait.

409.description: already resolved, or the 48h hold hasn't expired

get.description: Admin-only (Council/Associate title). Returns rocks a contribution was filed loosely against, from two signals: the contributor explicitly picked "Not sure which one" (reason "said_unsure"), or the rock is unnamed, photoless and holds exactly one problem (reason "looks_unsure"). Rocks already merged away are excluded.
get.summary: List rocks that were filed loosely and may need tidying

delete.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title) on any rock, or the rock's own creator. Refuses a rock that still has problems: move them to the right rock first (re-parenting), or purge the whole spot if it is junk.

403.description: not the creator and not an admin

409.description: rock still has problems on it

delete.summary: Delete a rock that has no problems on it

put.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title) on any boulder, or the boulder's own creator. A non-empty crag_id re-parents the boulder to a different spot, cascading its problems' denormalized crag_id along with it. Any field left out keeps its current value. lat and lng move as a pair: omit both to leave the rock's pin alone, or send either to replace both with what was sent (null clears the pin). An empty type also leaves the type alone.

403.description: not the creator and not an admin

get.description: Every problem-on-this-boulder's annotation together -- one photo, many lines.
get.summary: List every line drawn on a boulder's photos

delete.summary: Remove one image from a boulder

post.description: Appends URLs already uploaded via POST /upload/topo to a boulder's image_urls.

get.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title) on any boulder, or the boulder's own creator -- the visibility a creator needs to actually see and object to a request filed against their rock (see object, above). The admin-wide queue (list, below) stays unscoped and admin-only; this is scoped to one boulder.
get.summary: List pending merge requests filed against one boulder

post.description: Any authenticated user may suggest a merge; executing one is admin-only (see resolve).
post.summary: Suggest that two boulders are the same rock

delete.description: Allowed for the comment's own author or an admin.

post.description: Any authenticated user may create a crag; no role gate.

delete.description: Admin-only (Council/Associate title). Refuses any crag that still has rocks, problems, or approach guides -- the cure half of handoff.md open item 8: re-parent the rocks off a duplicate spot first, then delete the emptied husk.

409.description: crag still has rocks, problems or approach guides

put.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title) on any crag, or the crag's own creator. Any field left out keeps its current value, and an empty string clears directions or access_notes.

403.description: not the creator and not an admin

get.description: "Jalan masuk" -- the walk in, photographed step by step. A crag may have several; each is a genuinely different walk.

delete.summary: Remove one image from a crag

post.description: Appends URLs already uploaded via POST /upload/topo to a crag's image_urls -- the approach shot.

Admin-only, irreversible. Deletes the crag, its rocks, its problems, and every send, comment, drawn line, report and approach guide beneath them, destroys the associated Cloudinary assets, and notifies each affected problem creator. The request must carry the exact counts returned by the preview: if the crag has changed since, the purge is refused rather than silently taking the difference with it. The response body holds the only surviving record of what was deleted.

409.description: confirmation does not match what is there now

post.summary: Purge a crag and everything under it

get.description: Admin-only. Returns the counts a purge would remove and the full snapshot of every row involved, so an admin can save the record before committing. Read-only -- nothing is deleted.
get.summary: Preview what purging a crag would destroy

get.description: Newest-updated first. List items omit payload -- the drafts overlay only needs id/intent/label/updated_at to render its rows.
get.summary: List the caller's own add-sheet drafts

post.description: The first autosave of an add-sheet session (handoff-drafts.md decision 3) -- created lazily, on the first real edit, not on opening the sheet.

delete.description: Explicit removal from the drafts overlay, or the client's own best-effort cleanup after the draft was submitted for real (handoff-drafts.md decision 5). Destroys every photo the draft ever staged, unless keep_photos=true -- the post-submit case, where those URLs are now the real problem/boulder/crag's own photo.

parameters.description: Skip Cloudinary cleanup -- pass true only when the draft's photos were just reused as a real entity's own photo
parameters.name: keep_photos

get.description: Fetched when resuming a draft from the drafts overlay.

put.description: Every autosave after the first. Any photo URL the previous version carried that this one doesn't is a provisional upload this write orphaned, and is best-effort destroyed in Cloudinary (handoff-drafts.md decision 10).

post.description: Public, rate-limited (3 per 5s per IP). Open to logged-out visitors -- runs OptionalAuth so a logged-in submitter's user_id is attached when present.
Owner-only.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's notifications, newest first.
Optional crag_id/boulder_id query params filter to one crag or boulder.

post.description: Any authenticated user may create a problem; no role gate. boulder_id is required -- crag_id is derived from the boulder, not supplied directly.

delete.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title) on any problem, or the problem's own creator. Does not touch the boulder's shared photos -- only the problem row and its own annotation (cascades).

put.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title) on any problem, or the problem's own creator. A non-empty boulder_id re-parents the problem to a different rock, dropping any annotation it had (a line on the old rock's photo means nothing on the new one). Any field left out keeps its current value. An empty string clears a text field, and height_m is cleared by sending null.

403.description: not the creator and not an admin

put.description: One vector-shape overlay per (problem, image_url). Allowed for admins or the problem's own creator.

post.summary: Add a comment to a problem

delete.summary: Remove one image from a problem

post.description: Appends URLs already uploaded via POST /upload/topo to a problem's image_urls -- beta/action shots, never the topo base.

post.summary: Toggle a send (tick) on this problem

get.summary: Whether the authenticated user has sent this problem

put.description: Only the profile's own user may call this. Any field left out keeps its current value. An empty string clears a text field, and title and tags are cleared by sending null. Changing title is refused unless the caller already holds an admin title.

get.summary: Get a profile's recent sends and problems
Total reaction counts on a profile
Which reactions the authenticated user gave this profile

post.description: Creates the user + profile rows in one transaction and sends a verification email; the whole signup is rolled back if the email fails to send.
